label: Every transient or immanent operator is IN_ACT_1 in some respect
paraphrase: OPEN generic operari sequitur esse: whatever operates, transiently or immanently, is in act in some respect. The pinned q.75 a.2 reading STMT-AQUINAS-OPERATION-ONLY-OF-BEING-IN-ACT is stated only of causing another; this is the analyst's extension to operating as such.
